name: Onna Gari M*nster Hunter♀ Hunter ~Kinkyuu Onna Hunter Hokaku Quest Hassei~
original_name: 女狩り M×nster Hunter♀ Hunter ～緊急・女ハンター捕獲クエスト発生～
source:
At the tavern, hunters with big hopes gather to form a party.
We all want to capture the same trophy... a woman!
It's not enough to pay for sex. We want to conquer!
Women! We want women! Let's hunt women!!!!! 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE078524.html]DLsite English[/url]]
